title: Sections over the pullback of a split cover form a limiting fan of modules
statement: Let f:Y -> X be a morphism of schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Let J be a finite set, possibly empty, V_j schemes, i_j:V_j -> Y clopen immersions [def-weil-open-immersion] forming a colimit cofan, and t_j:X -> V_j satisfy t_j ; i_j ; f = id_X and i_j ; f ; t_j = id_V_j. Put s_j=t_j ; i_j. For a sheaf H of modules over a commutative ring Lambda on the small etale site of Y [def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and an etale W -> X, the fan in ModuleCat(Lambda) with vertex H(W times_X Y) [def-pc-fibre-product] and legs H(sigma_j,W), where sigma_j,W is the pullback lift of id_W and W -> X -> Y via s_j, is a limiting fan. This statement is at a fixed W and asserts neither naturality in W nor an isomorphism of sheaves.

proof.text: Install the open-immersion instances and the inverse isomorphisms t_j and i_j ; f. Let sigma_j be the displayed pullback lift. The square with top sigma_j, left W -> X -> V_j, right the pullback projection to Y and bottom i_j is cartesian: cancel the cartesian square W times_X Y over X from the outer square with horizontal isomorphisms id_W and i_j ; f, using IsPullback.of_right. Thus sigma_j is an open immersion and its range is the inverse image of range(i_j) under the projection to Y (IsPullback.isOpenImmersion_fst and Scheme.range_snd_of_isPullback in WeilConjectures.Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.PullbackCarrier). Its monicity descends through the faithful forgetful functor from the small etale site to schemes.

proof.text: Use the coproduct isomorphism e : coproduct V_j -> Y determined by hcolim. Transport the covering property of sigmaOpenCover V along the homeomorphism of e to see that the ranges of i_j cover Y. Transport equality of points back along this homeomorphism and apply sigmaι_eq_iff to prove that these ranges are pairwise disjoint. Pull back coverage and disjointness along the projection to Y using the range identities from step 1. The jointly-surjective criterion of Scheme.ofArrows_mem_smallEtaleTopology_iff makes the generated sieve covering. This works for an empty index type without selecting an index unless a point of the pullback is given.

proof.text: Apply Scheme.Etale.isIso_piLift_of_disjoint to H and the monic disjoint covering family sigma. ModuleCat has the requisite product because J is finite. The resulting IsIso of the restriction map Pi.lift is equivalent to Nonempty (IsLimit (Fan.mk ...)) by Fan.nonempty_isLimit_iff_isIso_piLift. This proves the original limiting fan with exactly its displayed legs; no new intermediate statements or sorries are needed.

theorem splitCoverSectionsLimit
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {J : Type w} [Finite J]
    {Λ : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing Λ]
    (f : Y ⟶ X) (V : J → Scheme.{u}) (i : ∀ j, V j ⟶ Y)
    (t : ∀ j, X ⟶ V j)
    (hcolim : IsColimit (Cofan.mk Y i))
    (hinv₁ : ∀ j, t j ≫ i j ≫ f = 𝟙 X)
    (hinv₂ : ∀ j, i j ≫ f ≫ t j = 𝟙 (V j))
    (hopens : ∀ j, AlgebraicGeometry.IsOpenImmersion (i j))
    (hclosed : ∀ j, AlgebraicGeometry.IsClosedImmersion (i j))
    (H : Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) (W : X.Etale) :
    letI : ∀ j, IsOpenImmersion (i j) := hopens
    letI : ∀ j, IsIso (t j) := fun j ↦
      ⟨⟨i j ≫ f, hinv₁ j, hinv₂ j⟩⟩
    let s := fun j ↦ t j ≫ i j
    Nonempty (IsLimit (Fan.mk
      (H.obj.obj (op ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ f).obj W)))
      (fun j ↦ H.obj.map (MorphismProperty.Over.homMk
        (A := (MorphismProperty.Over.map ⊤ (inferInstance : Etale (s j))).obj W)
        (B := (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ f).obj W)
        (pullback.lift (𝟙 W.left) (W.hom ≫ s j)
          (by
            change (𝟙 W.left) ≫ W.hom = (W.hom ≫ s j) ≫ f
            simp [s, Category.assoc, hinv₁ j]))
        (by simp)).op)))
